messages:
elaine: Heads-up  starting split/rename refactor today. Im breaking into micro-PRs so previews stay fast and we can canary.

sam: please post PR links when available. Ill take file-move reviews and sanity-check anchors.

maria: Ill own redirects and the redirect validator. Will produce a single-line JSON mapping for each moved path.

docsbot: preview queued for PRs, use preview hub: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/ 

elaine: Merge order plan (atomic canary):
1) small canary subset of moves -> preview green
2) partial redirect map for canary
3) monitor 20-30m, then continue with remaining moves + redirects

sam: local prechecks I run: `python tools/linkcheck.py docs/ --anchors` and `scripts/build_search_index.sh` to catch title/anchor drift.

ci-bot: CI status: canary PR preview: building. Tag @sam @maria for quick reviews when ready.

maria: note: do NOT run global search reindex during the merge window; platform will schedule post-merge reindex and CDN warm.

elaine: Targeting Thu 09:00 PT for canary merge. If anything breaks add label `hold/merge-block` and ping #release-war-room.

sam: acknowledged, will review promptly. Keep PRs small and one-threaded.
